method: BWF rally-scoring state machine: the rally winner gains one point and becomes the serving side. A game ends at 21 with a two-point lead from 20-all, or immediately at 30; the game winner serves first in the next game. Two game wins end the best-of-three match. Even serving-side scores indicate the right service court and odd scores the left. A change-of-ends event is emitted when either side first reaches 11 in game three. Undo restores the complete prior state, and scoring is refused after the match. Individual doubles player rotation, intervals, lets and umpire decisions are not modelled. Names and scores remain only in page memory.

sources.title: Badminton World Federation, Statutes Section 4.1 — Laws of Badminton, Version 5.0 (2), in force 26 April 2025: Laws 7, 8, 10.3 and 11.3
